content: Calcium and integrin-binding protein 1 (CIB1) is a protein encoded by the CIB1 gene in humans. This protein belongs to the calcium-binding protein family. While its precise biological function has not yet been fully elucidated, it is known to interact with DNA-dependent protein kinase (DNA-PK), suggesting a potential role in the regulation of kinase and phosphatase activity during DNA end-joining processes. Additionally, CIB1 interacts with integrin alpha(IIb)beta(3), indicating that it may function as a regulatory molecule for this integrin complex. CIB1 has been experimentally demonstrated to interact with several other proteins, including RAC3, presenilin-2 (PSEN2), the catalytic subunit of DNA-PK (DNA-PKcs), ubiquitin-protein ligase E3 component n-recognin 5 (UBR5), and CD61.
